Name: Rare's Rare Alex Portrait
Author: Rareismyname
Description:
▬▬▬▬▬▬

[size=3]This mod changes Alex's portraits to be more accurate to my own depiction of him. [/size][size=3]The idea was to keep his facial structure, features, and expressions as close as I could to the original.[/size]

[size=2]Nonetheless, I made a few tweaks, such as:
[/size]
— [i]A hairstyle that actually makes sense (for me, at least)[/i]
— [i]Adding bottom eyelashes.[/i]
— [i]Complete overhaul of his chest (I’m not quite fond of the one in the original…)[/i]
— [i]Darker skin and freckles and moles all over his body.[/i]
— [i]Giving him his fifth finger back (which he was missing)[/i]

 ̶T̶h̶e̶ ̶v̶a̶n̶i̶l̶l̶a̶ ̶s̶p̶r̶i̶t̶e̶ ̶i̶s̶ ̶c̶o̶m̶p̶l̶e̶t̶e̶l̶y̶ ̶p̶e̶r̶f̶e̶c̶t̶ ̶f̶o̶r̶ ̶m̶e̶ ̶s̶t̶i̶l̶l̶,̶ ̶t̶h̶o̶u̶g̶h̶.̶

It has been tested several times and in different saves, and so far it has worked perfectly!

▬▬▬▬▬▬

[size=3][b]How to install and use:
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Download Portraiture and PyTK.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract both and put them on the mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Download this mod.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract it and drag the folder “Rare’s Rare Alex Portrait Mod” to “Portraits” inside Portraiture.[/size]
[*][size=2]Launch the game, find Alex, talk to him, and press P while the DialogBox is open.[/size]
[*][size=2]Done![/size]
[/list]
Keep in mind that you also need ContentPatcher and SMAPI for this to work.

▬▬▬▬▬▬

In case of any issues, please let me know!
